description: The findings ledger's rules: fix rounds converge or stop, the checker and verifier run on opus, no agent pushes or merges, and an open ledger holds the turn. Node starts only below a folder holding .sdlc/runs.

hooks.command: d=$PWD; while [ -n "$d" ]; do [ -d "$d/.sdlc/runs" ] && exec node "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/guard.mts"; d=${d%/*}; done
